Patch Set 2:

(4 comments)

AI code review results below, please doublecheck

Some concerns, see inline comments. The main one is whether this actually closes the path that produced the bucket self-loop: I could not find a caller that reaches ll_splice_alias() with a hashed dentry, so the new d_drop() may never execute and whatever hashed that dentry would stay unfixed. Naming the path in the commit message would settle it. The remaining comments are optional nits for the same refresh.

commit.subject: LU-20681 llite: guard d_add() against a hashed dentry
commit.message:
LU-20681 llite: guard d_add() against a hashed dentry

d_add() rehashes its dentry unconditionally, and ll_splice_alias() is
also called with hashed dentries.  Such a dentry gets relinked into
the bucket it already sits on and its d_hash.next ends up pointing at
itself, so a later __d_lookup() on that bucket spins forever.

Unhash the dentry before d_add().

Fixes: 7334a2d33cc4 ("LU-8371 llite: optimize atomic_open of negative dentry.")
